about: The schematic corpus (#1687): the hand-made schematics (hand/, Silinx own, AGPL-3.0-only, drawn by make-hand.mjs), the ISE fixtures (test/fixtures/ise-sch/) and the gates example, each with its reference (an HDL design of the same behaviour); run by run.mjs and test/schematic-corpus.test.js. The schematics generated from the design corpus (test/designs-corpus/manifest.json) are made at run time, never committed.

schematics.name: bus_taps
schematics.covers: Bus taps: one bit, several bits, bits in the other order through a bus join, a tap of an internal bus, taps into a gate.

schematics.name: bus_taps_turned
schematics.covers: Bus taps turned (90, 180, 270), mirrored, the markers on their four sides: y is a, bit by bit.

schematics.name: bus_join
schematics.covers: Bus joins of parts of several widths, a join of joins, a bus split again by taps.

schematics.name: net_names
schematics.covers: Nets joined by name only: a bus named d(3:0), names used in several places, a marker's net named after it.

schematics.name: gates_inverted
schematics.covers: Gates of 2 to 5 inputs, with inverted inputs (AND2B1, OR3B2, NAND3B1, AND4B2), NOR, XOR, XNOR, and bitwise gates of a width.

schematics.name: vcc_gnd
schematics.covers: VCC and GND, of one bit and of a width, constants, a constant into an adder.

schematics.name: arith
schematics.covers: An adder with carry in and out, a subtractor with borrow out, comparators (unsigned and signed).

schematics.name: mux_dec
schematics.covers: Multiplexers (M2_1 of a width, M4_1, M8_1 with its select as a bus), a decoder with enable, a priority encoder, a demultiplexer.

schematics.name: flipflops
schematics.covers: Flip-flops (FD, FDC, FDCE, FDRE, FDPE, FTCE), a register and up / down counters, the clock through a BUFG.

schematics.name: tristate
schematics.covers: Tri-state buffers (BUFE, BUFT) sharing one net, a bus of them.

schematics.name: half_adder
schematics.covers: A half adder (the module the full adder instantiates).

schematics.name: full_adder
schematics.covers: A full adder of two half adders: module symbols of another schematic of the project.

schematics.name: curved_hops
schematics.covers: Wires drawn as curves, crossing without connecting (hops), a wire with a bend on another's segment.

schematics.name: bus_bitnames
schematics.covers: ISE's way of tapping a bus: the tap's wire named a(0), the bit it takes (#1688).

schematics.name: bus_offset
schematics.covers: A bus named d(7:4) and a tap of its bit 7 (#1689).

schematics.name: tap_range
schematics.covers: A tap of bit 5 of a 4-bit bus (#1690).

schematics.name: tap_reversed
schematics.covers: A tap with its MSB below its LSB, MSB 1 and LSB 2 (#1691).

schematics.name: ise-MyAND2b4
schematics.covers: an ISE schematic (test/fixtures/ise-sch/README.md): imported, saved, exported and imported again

schematics.covers: the gates example: bus taps, a bus join, NOT / AND / OR / NAND gates
